io.milvus.common.utils

Class JsonUtils

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.common.utils.JsonUtils

  • public class JsonUtils
extends Object
    JSON serialization and deserialization helpers backed by a thread-safe Gson instance.

    The underlying Gson is configured with the LONG_OR_DOUBLE number policy so that integer values are parsed as long and float values as double.
